title: Friction coefficient answer
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the coefficient of kinetic friction μ must be correct (5/7 or approximately 0.714).

title: Total time answer
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the total time t must be correct (4.8 s).

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the work-energy theorem from point b to point d, accounting for gravity, friction, and initial kinetic energy.

title: Motion analysis on bc
description: Important: For the rough incline (bc), the solution must correctly determine the acceleration or use kinematics (average velocity) to find the time t1.

title: Motion analysis on cd
description: Important: For the smooth incline (cd), the solution must correctly analyze the constant-acceleration motion to find the time t2.

title: Geometric height calculation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the vertical height h1 = L sin θ for the work-energy theorem.

title: Velocity at point c
description: Important: The solution must correctly find the velocity at point c (2√10 m/s) as an intermediate step for the time calculation.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the signs for the work done by gravity and friction are reversed or incorrectly combined in the energy equation.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answers are presented without units or with incorrect units (e.g., missing 's' for time).
